findings.evidence: The changed-context self-check explicitly asks learners to say the ticket printed within two seconds as well as that the queue stayed long. The first model says only 'in a flash' and that the queue remained long, omitting the supplied two-second fact; the second model includes it.
findings.repair: Add 'within two seconds' to the first model or make the precise duration optional in the self-check. Preserve that only ticket printing, not the queue, was fast; recheck any edited glossary spans.

findings.evidence: The self-check asks learners to identify that uploads were opened to all residents and this caused the sudden large intake. The second model says only 'The archive opened the floodgates to photo submissions' without the public-opening fact, so its causal trigger is less concrete than the prompt and first model require.
